response: Yes, patients who have undergone Assisted Reproductive Technology (ART) treatments, such as in vitro fertilization (IVF), often face higher rates of cesarean sections (C-sections) during delivery. This is due to various factors, including multiple pregnancies, advanced maternal age, and underlying health conditions that may have contributed to their infertility. Additionally, ART pregnancies are often considered high-risk, which may lead to a more cautious approach to delivery, resulting in a higher likelihood of a C-section.
